Shared arguments for npcompete metric functions

Source: R/npcompete-params.R
npcompete-params.Rd

Shared arguments for npcompete metric functions

Arguments

df

A data frame with one row per organization-year.

geography

Name of the column that identifies the market's geography, such as "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS" or "COUNTY_FIPS".

subsector

Name of the column that identifies the subsector. When it is "NTEEV2", the first three characters (the major group) are used.

resource

Name of the numeric column that measures organization size, such as "TOTREV", "TOTEXP" or "NETASS". Negative values are set to zero.

year

Name of the column that identifies the year, such as "TAXYEAR".

population

Name of the column that holds the market's population, such as "POP_METRO" or "POP_COUNTY". Ignored, and may be NULL, when pop_table is supplied.
